## What you want to add or change

One or two sentences. (New lesson, major rewrite, and new translation languages all start here, per the two-tier rule in CONTRIBUTING.md.)

## Where it fits

Which module, and which existing lessons it builds on or follows.

## What the learner will build or be able to do

The outcome, not the topic list.

## The quality bar

Confirm you have read the lesson quality bar in CONTRIBUTING.md, and note:

- Runnable code plan, on the standard library:
- Exercise and worked solution included? (yes)
- Estimated length / difficulty:

## Anything else

Links to drafts, prior art, or your own related work.
